text: Our actions Post-doctoral Study grants Post-doctoral Study grants Each year, the Fyssen Foundation funds around thirty international researchers through its postdoctoral fellowship program. Post-doctoral study grants Goals Study grants are ment for post-doctoral researchers, working on research disciplines such as Ethology, Paleontology, Archaeology, Anthropology, Psychology, Epistemology, Logic and Sciences of nervous system. These grants are awarded to french or foreign researchers, holders of a foreign Phd and who wish to achieve their project in a Laboratory in France; or either french or foreign researchers holders of a french Phd who wish to achieve their project in a Laboratory abroad (excluded co-tutorship country) Eligibility criteria Start its first post-doctoral fellowship with this financial support. If the recipient has already reached its host lab, he should be settled for no more than 3 monthsmaximum at the date of September 1st, 2026. Be 35 year old maximum on the closing day of the call. Be a holder of a Phd of less than two years on September 1st of the year of application, or achieve its viva thesis on December 31st of the year of application at the latest. The applicant should have achieved its PhD before starting the fellowship. The grants are open to researchers of all nationalities who hold: a doctoral degree obtained abroad for a project to be carried out in France; a doctoral degree obtained in France for a project to be carried out abroad. Mobility to a country where the doctoral degree was prepared under a joint supervision (co-tutelle) agreement is not eligible. Regarding the host laboratories located in France : the recipient hosted within a framework of a fixed-term contract will have to make sure that a convention of co-financing can be signed between the Foundation and the laboratory to reach the level of the gross salary. Note: The Foundation places great importance on the scientific integrity of the research it funds. It is essential that research be conducted in accordance with the core values of scientific integrity—honesty, rigor, transparency, reproducibility, independence, and accountability—as well as the more specific guiding principles adopted by the institutions and stakeholders with whom the applicant collaborates.When designing your research project, make sure to apply your institution’s code of conduct and ethical guidelines, as well as those of the stakeholders and collaborators with whom you will be working. Amount of the grant These grants, of an annual maximum amount of 45 000 euros, intend to cover expenses of hosting, stay and health insurance. Duration of the grant Grants are allocated from 12 months, not renewable, or 24 months subject to the approval of the Scientific commitee after examination of a report at the end of first year. The Post doctoral fellowship will start on September 1st of the application year the earliest and at the latest on January of the following year. Timeline February 2nd, 2026: Online application forms.March 31, 2026 12:00 Pm ( noon) French time ( Gmt+1) closing of the applications The receipt of the online application will be notified by an email confirmation.Mid July 2026: Results sent by post. Modalités The application form is to be necessarily completed ONLINE. Requested documents to complete the folder : The application form An invitation letter of the host laboratory (If there are 2 laboratories, provide 2 letters) The letters of two scientific personalities able to evaluate the program and the research of the candidate (A letter of recommendation can not be written by a member belonging to the host laboratory, but it may come from a thesis supervisor, a member of your thesis examiners, for example) The research project on 8 pages maximum drafted in English (Font size 12, simple interline 1,0) A complete description of the research project including: (a) objectives, (b) methods used to collect data and data analysis (c) expected results and their theoretical significance. Please explain how the project is related to the goals of the Foundation The CV and major publications of the candidate The abstract (150 words) of the research project as well as a list of 6 keywords. In French AND in English The Phd diploma copy or an attestation testifying the candidate will achieve his viva on December 31st 2025 the latest N.B: The Fyssen foundation attaches great importance to the scientific integrity of the research it funds. It is essential that scientific research is conducted in accordance with general guiding principles of scientific integrity — honesty, diligence, transparency, reproducibility, independence, responsibility — as well in accordance with any more specific guiding principles used by the institutions and stakeholders with whom the applicant collaborates. When designing your research project, have you applied the code of conduct and ethic regulations of your institution as well as the ones of institutions and stakeholders with whom you will work? Download the poster Post-doctoral study grants: Modus operandi 1 To apply, the candidate must complete the online form , choose its own login and submit its file to the Foundation 2 Once the candidate is validated by the Foundation, he will receive an e-email enclosing his password and login 3 The application form as well as your folder will be available, please use the username and password provided in the email to login 4 The candidate has to fill in all the requested informations in the forms, and download all required documents. This step can be done in several times. 5 Closing date for online application: March 31, 2026, 12 :00 (noon) Am french time ( GMT +1) 6 The candidate’s application will be submitted to the Scientific Committee and he will receive the result by email mid July 2025. FAQ How does the applicant get its login ? The applicant has to create its own login. Are there any restrictions regarding host countries or nationalities ? No, there is none. See the eligibility criteria above What financial contribution is expected from the host laboratory for a Fyssen postdoctoral fellowship in France? Depending on the salary scale of each institution, additional funding may be required. Applicants are encouraged to contact the Human Resources department or the department of “Partenariats et Valorisation de la Recherche” of their host laboratory to obtain a salary simulation and determine any amount that may need to be supplemented. What are the deadlines to start the fellowship ? The post doctoral project may start on September 1st, 2026 the earliest, and on very beginning of January 2027 the latest. May the project be drafted in english ? Yes, the project may be drafted in english. May the applicant add a third recommendation’s letter to its folder ? Yes, he may add one or several recommendation’s letters . When the applicant is submitting a project to be achieved in two host laboratories, does he have to submit two invitation letters ? Yes , he has to provide two invitation letters mentioning the date and duration of its stay. In which language the letters should be drafted ? They should be drafted either in french or in english. In case of another language it should be posted with a translation in French or in English. A scientific researcher wishes to keep its letter confidential, may he send the document directly to the Foundation ? Any personality who wishes to transmit a letter (dated and signed) may send it either by email (to secretariat@fondationfyssen.fr). All documents should be received BEFORE the deadline of the call. My viva is scheduled after the closing date, what document do I have to provide to be added to my folder? You will have to add a letter from your thesis director certifying your viva will be achieved before December 31st, 2026. What is the deadline if I need to replace documents in my folder? You may add or delete any document before the final validation of your folder. Once clicked, you will not have access to your folder anymore and shall have to contact the Foundation in case of a mistake and send us the document to be replaced. I defended my thesis in France. Can I carry out my project in a French institute located in another country? No. The host laboratory must not be French if you defended your thesis in France, even if it is located in another country.
